title: Build and verify HyperShot for Minecraft 26.2
objective: Turn the existing HyperShot alpha source into a polished, production-quality client-side Minecraft 26.2 Fabric screenshot mod with real extreme-resolution tiled rendering, robust state restoration, bounded-memory encoding, a usable gallery and notification experience, complete documentation, and verified Java 25 CI artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: The source repository branch contains a complete Minecraft 26.2 Fabric project using Java 25, official Mojang names, Loader 0.19.3, Fabric API 0.156.0+26.2, Loom 1.17.17, and Gradle 9.5.1 or a documented confirmed-compatible 9.5.x release
The project compiles and ./gradlew clean build succeeds in GitHub Actions
Native, scaled off-screen, and tiled captures produce valid PNG output through backend-independent Blaze3D APIs without raw OpenGL calls
A synthetic 10000x10000 tiled capture path is verified without retaining the full final image in Java heap
HUD and renderer state are restored on success, failure, and cancellation
A real clickable thumbnail, preview screen, indexed gallery, settings, diagnostics, metadata, recovery, and progress systems are functional
No visible UI control represents an unimplemented feature as finished
Unit tests, source guards, JAR inspection, and a headless OpenGL development-client startup smoke test pass
The final JAR and complete verification evidence are uploaded as GitHub Actions artifacts
Remaining Vulkan, shader-pack, codec, HDR, panorama, and advanced-pass limitations are documented honestly
